cases.scenario: Build a FIFO queue with 10 at 100 and 20 at 200 on a non-batchwise-valued batch. Receive five at 300 and submit a linked purchase return.
cases.assertion: The receipt appends [5,300]. The return restores [[10,100],[20,200]].

cases.scenario: Receive two lots of 10 in one batch with batchwise valuation off, the first at 100 and the second at 200. Return five against the first receipt.
cases.assertion: The active ledger row carries a stock value of 2500 and layers [[5,100],[10,200]].

cases.scenario: Receive 10 units into batch A at 100 and 10 into batch B at 200 with a LIFO item and batchwise valuation disabled. Issue 5 explicitly from batch A.
cases.assertion: With A explicitly selected, the active ledger value falls by 1000 and the remaining queue is [[10,100],[5,200]].

cases.scenario: Receive two serials each in batches expiring in 60 and five days. Request two serials using the Expiry selector.
cases.assertion: The set of batch IDs of all returned serials is exactly the five-day batch.

cases.scenario: Receive two units of one batch. Two sales orders reserve one each. Explicitly assign that batch to each mapped delivery row.
cases.assertion: Both delivery notes submit with document status 1.

cases.scenario: Receive two batches of two. Reserve two for order A. Assign the reserved batch to an unreserved delivery for order B.
cases.assertion: Submission raises the reservation validation error even with stock available in the other batch.

cases.scenario: An order reserves two serials. Deliver one from the reservation and return the delivery. Create and reserve a new one-unit order.
cases.assertion: The new submitted reservation has exactly the returned serial in its child rows.

cases.scenario: Request three whole boxes of 12 against 25 available stock units with partial reservation enabled.
cases.assertion: The reservation records 24 stock units.

cases.scenario: Submit two item/warehouse rebuild requests with auto-run held. Set the earlier request’s in-memory start time to 60 seconds before creation of the later request and call deduplication.
cases.assertion: The later request remains Queued in the database.

cases.scenario: Set a submitted rebuild to Completed and request restart. Repeat with its saved state set to Failed.
cases.assertion: The first request raises a validation error. The failed rebuild restarts with status Queued.

cases.scenario: Receive 10 at 100, issue five later and cancel the original receipt. With negative stock enabled for the item, execute its pending voucher rebuild with allow_zero_rate set.
cases.assertion: The rebuild reaches Completed.

cases.scenario: Receive 10 at 100, move five to another warehouse, then issue two there. Insert 10 at 200 before the transfer. Queue overlapping item/warehouse rebuilds on the source and destination.
cases.assertion: Executing the source request gives statuses Completed and Skipped. A forwarding call recorder counts one replay per destination row. Destination stock values become 750 and 450.

cases.scenario: Transfer 45 units from stores to finished goods. Read each warehouse inventory account, inspect the applicable posting branch, then cancel the voucher.
cases.assertion: Stock ledger quantities are −45 and +45. The test checks absence of GL rows for a shared account or a source credit and matching target debit for distinct accounts. The result records success for the executed branch.

cases.scenario: Submit component consumption of 10 at 100. On a work order for 10 finished units, allocate 25 percent of component costs to a five-unit scrap output and save the manufacture draft.
cases.assertion: Posted consumption totals 1000. The draft carries 750 for finished goods and 250 for scrap, with 1000 total incoming value.

cases.scenario: Receive five each into two material batches, transfer 10 to work in progress, submit two manufactures of five, then submit two disassemblies of five.
cases.assertion: The multiset of the two returned material batch IDs equals the multiset of the original receipts.

cases.scenario: Prepare a manufacture using two units of a raw item, one designated finished output, and an additional one-unit target row with neither output classification.
cases.assertion: The manufacture command raises a validation error.

cases.scenario: Receive a batched quantity of 10 at 100, submit the first closing with enqueue held, call its balance builder, and calculate the next closing opening.
cases.assertion: The first closing reaches Completed. The subsequent item/warehouse total is 10 units and 1000 in value.

cases.scenario: Start the closing balance builder. After it creates balance rows, a wrapper sets the document cancelled at that explicit point and lets the worker finish.
cases.assertion: The wrapper confirms provisional balance rows existed. The completed call leaves state Cancelled and removes all balance rows linked to that closing.

cases.scenario: Submit an item/warehouse rebuild in March with test auto-execution held. Attempt a closing through March 31 in the same company.
cases.assertion: Closing submission raises PendingRepostingError.

cases.scenario: Receive 10 at 100, build a closing, then insert five more units at 100 before its date. Run the Stock Balance report after the closing.
cases.assertion: The closing becomes Outdated. Both the report opening and balance quantities are 15.
